notes: Existing stories are complete, non-duplicative, and fully cover schema, logic, API exposure, testing, and integration. No changes required.

stories.title: Define Enrollment Status Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a normalized schema for clinical trial enrollment status (recruiting, active, completed, terminated, unknown) and explicitly map all known ClinicalTrials.gov status values into this contract, including a fallback category for unmapped values.

stories.title: Implement Enrollment Status Extraction and Normalization Logic
stories.description: Extract enrollment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API responses and normalize values into the defined schema, including handling nulls, deprecated statuses, and unexpected values without breaking downstream processing.

stories.title: Expose Enrollment Status via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate normalized enrollment status into the clinical trials response returned by evaluate_care_facade, ensuring consistent field naming and inclusion in all trial result objects returned to the chat layer.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Enrollment Status Normalization
stories.description: Create unit tests validating correct mapping of all known ClinicalTrials.gov statuses into normalized categories, including edge cases such as missing fields, unexpected values, and casing inconsistencies.

stories.title: Integration Test for Enrollment Status in Clinical Trial Results
stories.description: Validate end-to-end flow of enrollment status from ClinicalTrials.gov API through service normalization and facade exposure into the final response payload, ensuring consistency across multiple trial records.
